# The CTS catches loader failures and therefore opts back into C++ exceptions.
# MSVC and clang-cl inherit /EHsc from the first-party compiler policy.
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(libhrx_cts_core PRIVATE "-fexceptions")
endif()
